issues.problem: kg-o-suru explain: お寝します given as an example of an action that reaches no one, but 寝る is also excluded by its one-syllable stem, so the example proves the wrong rule.
issues.action: Replaced with お走りします.

issues.problem: kg-sasete mistake: 部長、この書類をチェックさせていただけませんか is a correct, natural request to check the document oneself; the sentence does not show it is wrong.
issues.action: Rewrote as 私の企画書を読ませていただけませんか (bad) / 読んでいただけませんか (good), where asking permission to read your own proposal is plainly wrong.

issues.problem: kg-teitadaku mistake: 体調が悪いので、明日休んでいただけませんか can be read as asking an unwell listener to rest, so the bad sentence is not clearly wrong.
issues.action: Added 私は to both bad and good so the speaker is the one who is unwell.

issues.problem: kg-teitadaku example: 送っていただきました translated 'gave me a lift', but 送る does not say by car.
issues.action: English changed to 'Mr Tanaka kindly took me to the station.'
